notes: This contract records a bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 federate-designator identity invariant in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. Get Federate Handle remains limited to a currently joined federate name, while Get Federate Name retains the immutable name for a valid FederateHandle returned by Join after that federate resigns or is removed by the private Connection Lost path. The historical identity index is deliberately distinct from active-membership checks, so it does not authorize callbacks or any membership-sensitive service. This is source/test traceability only, not a service catalog entry, JUnit result, protected-review result, package claim, or conformance claim. Full restore/interoperability behavior remains separate work.
